counting_note: Physical repository reconciliation. Unique item counts deduplicate by AID, then source URL, then ID. Evidence-family files are counted separately. Public metrics and search index are regenerated after relevant pushes.
active_blocks: No permission for bulk copying of protected corpora; only bounded non-verbatim paraphrases and locators are stored.
Incoming correspondence is absent from many Igrot Kodesh response cases, so context remains Partial where the incoming question is unavailable.

answer_readiness.baseline_correction: The prior 878 content-Verified count was a false positive: eight batch-096 provenance.verification_status strings said 'no promotion to Verified', which status_of() matched as Verified. quality_gate.trigger: push to main on source items, answer engine and readiness tests
quality_gate.note: Hourly run 43755991899 on commit 1a75e775 observed answer_eligible=1009, content_verified=854 and propositions=3017 after conservative status normalization; the previous expected 870 was incorrect. Answer-quality run 43755991908 then exposed a duplicate const in the new test block. Both issues are corrected in the follow-up commit; reconciliation and a new commit-bound run are required. The batch-100 in-place enrichment also shifts the test chain: batch 100 expected-after and batch 101 before are 2969 propositions; batch 101 expected-after and batch 102 before are 2999. The hourly validation also exposed a latent retrieval regression: generic health correspondence entered a narrow dental-extraction/second-opinion answer. The answer engine now requires both dental-specific and additional-opinion evidence for that topic; the existing regression test covers the exclusion. The researcher response now exposes an explicit claim_source_map alongside the evidence_map, with source numbers, Evidence Family IDs and proposition-level locators for each claim. The cross-family regression question was tightened to explicitly name the two inspected talks and their distinct passages, avoiding an over-broad formulation. The full-corpus regular retrieval check remains; the deep researcher synthesis check is restricted to the two already-inspected source identities to keep the regression bounded and deterministic.

primary_user_question: עד כמה אפשר לסמוך על זה?
ux.default_experience: answer-first; technical provenance progressively disclosed; original source opens directly where lawful
ux.answer_model: proposition-grounded multi-source synthesis with high relevance threshold and numbered claim-level citations
ux.regular_mode: concise answer-first synthesis plus numbered evidence list
ux.researcher_mode: extended evidence analysis with subclaims, witness provenance, verification scope, context completeness, source-type/period/audience distinctions, Evidence Families, tensions and unanswered aspects
ux.language_policy: cross-language retrieval across Hebrew, Yiddish, English and any additional direct/authorized source languages; translations are derived, not independent witnesses
ux.precision_policy: precision over recall; lexical-only matches rejected; insufficient evidence is an acceptable result

verification_surge.effort_target: 75-85% promotion/verification until backlog is materially reduced; 15-25% breadth expansion
verification_surge.homogeneous_batch_target: 20-50 records when direct authorized item witnesses are stable and rights permit
blocking_reasons: metadata ambiguity or unresolved identity/dedup conflict

development_recovery.primary_bottleneck: Bibliographic identities are not inspected content; maintenance had no acquisition step and no content inspection.
development_recovery.required_agent_action: Inspect 8–15 or more public source bodies per run; prioritize original-language Hebrew/Yiddish and distinct documentary classes; enrich identities in place; deduplicate by AID/URL/ID and Evidence Family; keep translations and derived copies non-independent; preserve claim-level locators and deep researcher evidence maps.
development_recovery.last_batch_summary: Batch 102: nine new item identities in eight Evidence Families; one existing identity (AID 2989585) enriched in place; 18 new propositions and one additional proposition on the existing identity. No source promoted to Verified. Expected post-reconciliation counts are 1009 answer-eligible / 854 content-Verified / 3017 propositions.
development_recovery.last_run_note: AID 4666220 remained a public summary shell; AIDs 553672 (Hebrew) and 553691 (Yiddish) exposed audio/player metadata without transcript bodies. Ten alternative public bodies were inspected: nine new identities and an in-place enrichment of AID 2989585. AIDs 4280029 and 4280144 were excluded as already present; AID 3140253 was excluded as a Hebrew translation of a Yiddish source. AID 5989527 was linked to the same farbrengen Evidence Family as AID 5989563. No crawler retry, access-control bypass or full-text copying. Latest hourly validation run 43755991899 measured 1009/854/3017 after conservative status normalization, not the previously expected 1009/870/3017; the expected chain is corrected to 854. Answer-quality run 43755991908 stopped on a duplicate test variable declaration, now renamed in the follow-up commit. The follow-up test also aligns the proposition snapshots to 2969 after batch 100 and 2999 after batch 101, reflecting the in-place AID 2989585 enrichment. The hourly run also exposed a latent narrow-topic retrieval leak: generic health evidence entered a dental-extraction/second-opinion answer. A two-part evidence gate now requires explicit dental and additional-opinion terms. The researcher response now includes an explicit claim_source_map in addition to evidence_map, carrying source numbers, Evidence Family IDs and proposition-level locators for every claim. The cross-family test prompt was narrowed to an explicit comparison of the 19 Kislev talk on stating the gathering's purpose aloud and the 20 Kislev talk on extending the farbrengen through Torah study and mitzvah practice. The deep researcher regression now receives only the two inspected source identities; regular-mode retrieval still searches the full index. This preserves the retrieval test while bounding the expensive deep-synthesis check.
